articles.title: Indian Army's preparedness ensured Galwan clash did not escalate into war: Brig Shekhawat
articles.summary: Brigadier Saurabh Singh Shekhawat, then commander, asserted that the Indian Army's strong preparedness prevented the 2020 Galwan clash from escalating into a full-scale war with China. This highlights the army's strategic deterrence and effective on-ground management during a critical border confrontation, underscoring the importance of readiness in maintaining regional stability and national security interests.

articles.title: UPSC Key: India-Seychelles relations, PMKVY, and NUDGE campaign
articles.summary: This text outlines crucial examination topics, vital for aspirants. Preliminary exams demand strong knowledge of national and international current events. For Mains General Studies-II, the emphasis is on India's bilateral, regional, and global groupings and agreements. This guidance helps SSB aspirants prioritize areas like geopolitics and India’s foreign policy, critical for comprehensive preparation and understanding national and global dynamics.

articles.title: 'This is the status...': Former Army Chief Naravane issues first response on 'Four Stars of Destiny' memoir row
articles.summary: Former Indian Army Chief MM Naravane confirmed his upcoming memoir's status is unchanged, amidst significant Parliament uproar over its contents. The book has sparked political controversy, with claims about an advance copy. For SSB aspirants, this highlights how senior military memoirs can influence national discourse, revealing strategic insights and civil-military dynamics, making such publications crucial for understanding defence-related governance and leadership challenges.

articles.title: Citing React2Shell & Log4J, Dartmouth Health’s Plummer Says Lack of Granular Tech Inventory Still an Issue
articles.summary: Christopher Plummer, currently a Senior Cybersecurity Architect at Dartmouth Health, dedicated a decade as a cybersecurity contractor for the U.S. Navy. His crucial work involved supporting the vital submarine maintenance program. This highlights the indispensable role of cybersecurity expertise in safeguarding military assets and national defence infrastructure, a critical area for aspiring defence personnel to understand.

articles.title: Three Trustees appointed to The Imperial War Museums Board.
articles.summary: The Prime Minister has appointed Jeremy Bailey as Navy Trustee and Sir William Worsley as Estates Trustee. These significant governmental roles are for a four-year term, effective from February 1, 2026, until January 31, 2030. These appointments are crucial for the oversight and administration of naval affairs and associated estates.

articles.title: Show HN: Symdex-100 – Intent-based code search using 20-byte "Cypher" metadata
articles.summary: Symdex-100 is a new AI companion designed for advanced Python code exploration and search. It leverages semantic fingerprints for intent-based code discovery, achieving 50-100x faster index lookups and utilizing 10-50x fewer tokens for AI agents. This innovation significantly boosts development efficiency by enhancing AI's capability to understand and generate code, marking a substantial technological advancement.

articles.title: Somalia signs defence agreement with Saudi Arabia
articles.summary: Somalia and Saudi Arabia signed a defence agreement on February 9, 2026, marking a significant development in the strategically vital Horn of Africa. This deal underscores the region's increasing role as a theatre for proxy competition among Gulf monarchies. It highlights evolving geopolitical alignments, Saudi Arabia's expanding influence, and the critical importance of maritime security in international relations for SSB aspirants.
